summary: Audit and repair freshness of existing public project mentions
description: Compare every currently inventoried public GitHub project mention with current repository metadata, README/release evidence and live-site output; classify drift and repair only proven stale public claims.
acceptance: Every active public source repository in data/public-projects.json has dated freshness evidence and a classified outcome.
All public claims found stale by authoritative repository or live evidence are corrected without expanding unrelated site scope.
A repeatable local freshness check detects missing evidence and expired review dates.
Full repository checks, diff checks, critic review, and production readback pass.
